name: selene
description: Blazing-fast modern Lua linter written in Rust. Custom build (0.31.0 + PR #666 feature-forwarding, parser forced to LuaJIT) so it parses Lua 5.1 + goto/labels used by STALKER/Anomaly mods. Stock release binaries cannot parse goto.

selene.description: Modern multithreaded Lua linter with English error names and comprehensive static analysis
selene.usage:
selene src/ # Lint entire directory
selene script.lua # Lint single file
selene --config selene.toml . # Use custom config
selene --display-style=quiet src/ # Quiet output mode
selene --num-threads=4 src/ # Set thread count
selene --luau # Enable Luau syntax support
